status: Accepted as a documented alpha boundary cost; final package/integration and device acceptance remain separate.
rationale: The extracted borrowed-host API preserves live queue callbacks, dynamic definition replacement, per-grant stat publication, partial commits and bounded callback/collection work. Eliminating observations or skipping publication is not an equivalent optimization.
The eager reentry guard was replaced with bounded temporary storage, reducing measured retained overhead by approximately 96 bytes per used Actor. That verified change remains selected.
The additional timer fast path was tested and rejected by the criteria committed before timing. Keep its additional behavior tests and all positive and negative measurements.
Grant CPU samples spread across adapter, runtime and stat work. The observations do not isolate one removable operation or prove that validation alone explains the difference.

The current live borrowed-definition contract does not permit caching mutable definitions or modifier values solely by identity. An immutable executable-content path can be evaluated separately with explicit semantics and realistic workloads.

Keep the selected implementation and advance to packaging and remaining systems. Further optimization must be supported by allocation/whole-frame and target-device evidence, not indefinite retries of these same desktop trials.
scope: Four runs use different third graphs and therefore are not pooled as independent identically distributed samples or statistical confidence intervals.
The native and selected graphs share one process and instrumented call sites. These are batch comparisons, not isolated single-call latency or a whole-game speedup.
No absolute-optimization, FPS, target-device budget, Unity/Godot/Unreal compatibility or general storage-layout claim follows.
The small synthetic expiry result cannot substitute for ordinary gameplay performance.

SQLite remains an optional authoring/query projection; immutable capability data is prepared outside the runtime loop. Changing storage alone is not evidence that these observed runtime costs disappear.
